SETTINGS.TITLE: Company Settings
SETTINGS.SUBTITLE: Configure how your financial reports are calculated
SETTINGS.ALLOCATION_DESC: Determines how expenses with no assigned branch (global employees, shared rent, etc.) are distributed across your branches in financial reports.
SETTINGS.PROPORTIONAL_DESC: Global expenses are split between branches based on their share of total revenue. The more a branch earns, the more overhead it absorbs.
SETTINGS.PROPORTIONAL_EXAMPLE: If Branch A generates 70% of revenue and Branch B generates 30%, a global salary of 10,000 → Branch A pays 7,000, Branch B pays 3,000.
SETTINGS.PROPORTIONAL_BEST: Best for most businesses. Prevents a small branch from being crushed by overhead it can't afford, while ensuring high performers carry their fair share.
SETTINGS.EQUAL_DESC: Global expenses are divided equally among all branches, regardless of their revenue.
SETTINGS.EQUAL_EXAMPLE: With 2 branches, each pays exactly 50% of the global salary. With 3 branches, each pays 33.3%.
SETTINGS.EQUAL_BEST: Use this when the global employee truly spends equal time at each location.
SETTINGS.EQUAL_WARNING: If one branch earns much less than another, the 50% overhead hit may make it look unprofitable on paper.
SETTINGS.OVERHEAD_DESC: Global expenses are NOT charged to any branch. They are subtracted from total company profit after branch contributions are calculated.
SETTINGS.OVERHEAD_EXAMPLE: Each branch shows its "contribution" (revenue minus direct costs). Company net profit = total contribution minus global overhead.
SETTINGS.OVERHEAD_BEST: Best for executive roles (CEO, owner, accountant) whose work grows the whole company, not just one branch.
SETTINGS.OVERHEAD_WARNING: Branch-level "Net Profit" will look artificially high because it doesn't reflect the true cost of the management layer.
SETTINGS.AUTO_SESSIONS_DESC: Automatically start and end class sessions based on each class's weekly schedule.
SETTINGS.AUTO_SESSIONS_LABEL: Auto start & end sessions on time
SETTINGS.AUTO_SESSIONS_HINT: When enabled, a session starts automatically when its class is scheduled to begin, and ends when its scheduled time is over. The schedule is checked every few minutes. When off, sessions only start when you click Start.

TELEGRAM.SUBTITLE: Automatically send attendance (present/absent) to students and parents on Telegram, and let staff mark attendance by typing a student code into your bot.
TELEGRAM.BOT_HELP: Create a bot with @BotFather on Telegram, then paste its token here to connect.

TELEGRAM.HOW_TO_GET_TOKEN: How do I get a bot token?
TELEGRAM.INSTR_STEP1: Open Telegram and search for @BotFather (the official bot with the blue checkmark).
TELEGRAM.INSTR_STEP2: Send /newbot, then follow the prompts: pick a display name, then a username that must end in "bot" (e.g. my_academy_bot).
TELEGRAM.INSTR_STEP3: BotFather replies with a token that looks like 123456789:AAH...long-string... — copy it.
TELEGRAM.INSTR_STEP4: Paste that token in the field here and press "Connect bot".
TELEGRAM.INSTR_STEP5: Done! Your bot is connected and will send attendance and exam notifications to students/parents.
TELEGRAM.POOL_HELP: Create bots with @BotFather and add their tokens here. Each academy that turns Telegram on automatically claims one.
